added: A View error action for failed chapters in Download Manager, showing why a download did not complete.
fixed: Incomplete chapter downloads no longer leave you with only an unexplained error symbol.
Sensitive request URLs or credentials are not displayed in error dialogs, and locked source chapters are never bypassed.
improved: More useful error explanations for source access restrictions, missing chapter images, HTTP errors, connection failures and low storage.
Failure reasons reset when a chapter is retried and remain only in memory, not in backups or manga library records.
